name: elm-anydesk
description: Consent-based 1:1 screen sharing, optional audio, and private chat for Windows 11

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@elm/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@elm/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@elm/api && npm run build --workspace=@elm/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@elm/protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
